# teamrig-pane

> A Claude Code plugin that shows a session's teamrig tasks, and the files it changed in git, beside the conversation. It reads the register the teamrig CLI writes, lists and starts the team's meetings through that CLI, and through it has a session bring the owner its cards.

## Guide

- [teamrig-pane guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/SKILL.md): start here: requirements, install, the /teamrig-pane command, keys, the banner of the current task above the prompt, the Tasks view and its setup steps in a project teamrig is not set up for, its status bar, a task's card and its page with back and forward, a reference file's page, search, the archive of finished tasks a week at a time, the Changes view, each file's diff and a search of the files, the Log view of each conversation of the team's sessions, titled by its task, and a search of them, the Inbox view of the session's inbox lines, the Teams tab of the tree of teams the session's team is in, the pane's own session marked and each role in a colour of its own, each session's cards waiting on the owner and its Meet press, each session's card with its task counts and a search of the sessions, the Meetings view of the team's booked meetings, each one's card and its start press, how it relates to teamrig
- [Reference](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/reference.md): where it finds the register, its settings, each WARN line with its fix, its limits

## Design

- [Plugin README](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/README.md): every view, key and limit, and how the pane copies teamrig's reader

## Optional

- [teamrig guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/SKILL.md): the CLI that writes the tasks and inboxes the pane shows
